tracks.headline: Splits are disjoint by case everywhere (0 overlaps in carmlspine/cobra_elekta/deepfluoro/geneva, 0 in 4,620 crops and 5,212 carmlspine_multi images, 0 fold-test cases in any of the five DRR/context/mix banks, 0 fixed-test cases in carm_fov96_ctx/carm_mix; splits.json), no real-X-ray frame exists in any training corpus (0 pairs at NCC32 >= 0.97 against 37,165 film-corpus images, 29,484 FluoroCap panels, 1,445 yolo_v6f images; dupes.json), and the film detector v5z predates every download by 6-7 days. The defect is in the claim, not the data: the "100% sacrum on DeepFluoro test" is rx_pooled_1024, fine-tuned on five DeepFluoro specimens of the same Cios Fusion and initialised from anchor_none_v2_17-1882, whose 569 training renders were 44.8% (255) under the test specimen 18-1109's own poses and whose nine device terms were fitted on 255 real frames including all 104 of 18-1109 (splits.json render_detector). The render-only method with 18-1109 truly held out (anchor_none_v2_18-1109, three seeds) gives 88.5-91.3% sacrum recall at conf 0.05 and 67.3-83.7% at 0.25, and the v2 LOSO generation pools to 64.0% at 0.05 / 54.3% at 0.25 over 365 frames, 13 points below the manuscript's 76.9%, which comes from the earlier anchor_none_r2 generation. COBRA's 74,364 cross-split near-duplicates are same-gantry-angle laterals of different patients with no bony detail (contact sheet), so COBRA sacrum recall is partly a positional prior. Pose QC: film-detector boxes sit within 0.01 body heights of projected truth (AP/LAT medians), none beyond 0.4 (pose_qc.txt).

defects_found: CLAIM DEFECT: 'the same detector finds the sacrum in 100% of DeepFluoro test frames, against the 76.9% the manuscript reports' compares rx_pooled_1024 (fine-tuned on real frames of five DeepFluoro specimens on the same Cios Fusion, initialised from anchor_none_v2_17-1882) with a leave-one-specimen-out render-only number; the render-only method with 18-1109 held out gives 88.5-91.3% at conf 0.05 and 67.3-83.7% at 0.25. Not a leakage of frames, but not the manuscript's method either.

INDIRECT EXPOSURE: anchor_none_v2_17-1882 (the initialisation of every rx_* detector) drew 255 of 569 training renders (44.8%) under 18-1109's poses and used device terms and a photon range fitted on real frames that include all 104 of 18-1109; any number from these detectors on 18-1109 carries that geometry and pixel-statistics exposure (not anatomy).

TWO ARM GENERATIONS: the manuscript's 76.9% is the anchor_none_r2 generation; the anchor_none_v2 generation on disk (OR display window, the one in use) pools to 64.0% at 0.05 / 54.3% at 0.25 over the same 365 frames. Claims must name the generation.

LODO CHECKPOINT SELECTION: rx_lodo_{carmlspine,cobra_elekta,deepfluoro}_1024 select best.pt on the TEST splits of the two devices they train on (data.yaml val lists); only the held-out device's numbers from a lodo run are clean.

COBRA TEMPLATE EFFECT: 74,364 cross-case cross-split pairs at NCC >= 0.97 are same-angle laterals with no bony detail; COBRA sacrum recall (97.9% pooled) is partly a positional prior and must be read per angle bin.
